prediction.predicted_reply: Hello! Based on similar issues, sometimes thumbnail and preview problems are related to account permissions. You might try testing with a new user account to see if the issue persists, or check your folder permissions (such as in the Pictures folder) to ensure child object permissions are correctly applied. If the issue continues, please contact Microsoft support directly for further assistance.
